description: Customer (pelanggan) and mechanic (mekanik) role areas - the two service-tracking roles. Customer: self online booking, track the 5-stage progress, G6 invoice-PDF download after Diambil and an email-sent notice. Mechanic: see assigned tickets, advance status sequentially (never Diambil), add/remove parts with live stock feedback. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Create frontend/src/app/(pelanggan)/ guarded to role pelanggan (RoleGuard allow=['pelanggan']) with a layout/nav. Dashboard lists the customer's own bookings via useBookings (backend auto-scopes to their tickets) with StatusBadge and empty/loading states.

Build the create-online-booking form (react-hook-form + zod mirroring createOnlineBookingSchema: plateNumber 3-15, motorModel 2-50, complaint 3-500, optional serviceId chosen from the public catalog, optional serviceDate as ISO datetime). On success call createOnline, invalidate the bookings query, show a toast, and display a G6 notice that a confirmation email was sent to the account email.

Build the booking detail page for pelanggan showing the StatusStepper across Antre->Diperiksa->Dikerjakan->Selesai->Diambil (and a Dibatalkan state), statusHistory timeline, parts used, serviceFee/partsTotalCost/grandTotal via Rupiah. When status is Selesai, surface a G6 note that a completion email was sent. When status is Diambil, show a Download Invoice (PDF) button that fetches the PDF blob with the auth header (invoicePdfBlob) and triggers a browser download; hide it otherwise.
Create frontend/src/app/(mekanik)/ guarded to role mekanik with layout/nav. List assigned tickets via useBookings (backend scopes to mechanicId) with filters by status.

Build the mekanik ticket detail: a sequential status-advance control that offers ONLY the backend-allowed next status from ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS and never offers Diambil (enforced in UI and still safe if backend rejects). Include an optional mechanicNotes and serviceFee field on the status update where relevant.

On the mekanik ticket detail, add add-part (select from useParts with stock shown, quantity>=1) and remove-part controls, enabled only when status is Diperiksa or Dikerjakan; after add/remove, invalidate the booking and parts queries so stock reflects immediately, and show an error toast when the backend reports insufficient stock.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm run build and pnpm run lint pass.
A pelanggan can create an online booking and see it at status Antre; the confirmation-email notice appears.
The invoice Download PDF button appears only when the ticket status is Diambil and successfully downloads a PDF.
A mekanik sees only assigned tickets; the status control exposes only the legal next status and never Diambil.
Adding a part in Diperiksa/Dikerjakan deducts stock and removing restores it, reflected in the UI; insufficient-stock errors surface as a toast.
No hardcoded data: all lists/details come from the API.
verification: cd c:/Users/Acer/Documents/ANTIGRAV/bengkel-motor-6/frontend && pnpm run build && pnpm run lint

Manual (backend + seeded DB): as andi.pelanggan create a booking (Antre), open a Diambil ticket if owned and download its invoice; as budi.mekanik open an assigned ticket, advance status, add then remove a part and confirm stock changes. If no DB is available, record which steps were unverified.
findings:
FEAT-003 complete. Verification: `pnpm run build` + `pnpm run lint` both PASS; existing unit suite `pnpm run test` PASS (17 tests). Manual DB-backed flows (create online booking, invoice PDF download, mekanik status advance / part add-remove) NOT executed because backend MONGODB_URI is the placeholder and no live/in-memory DB is available in this environment; UI logic is wired against the real API with no hardcoded data.

Pages added (all 'use client', wrapped by RoleGuard via the group layout):
- (pelanggan) area, guarded allow=['pelanggan']: layout at src/app/(pelanggan)/layout.tsx (nav + logout). Routes: /pelanggan (dashboard, useBookings auto-scoped), /pelanggan/baru (create-online form), /pelanggan/[id] (detail).
- (mekanik) area, guarded allow=['mekanik']: layout at src/app/(mekanik)/layout.tsx. Routes: /mekanik (assigned list with status Tabs filter), /mekanik/[id] (detail with status advance + parts).

Conventions for FEAT-004/005 to reuse:
- Area layouts are client components that render <RoleGuard allowedRoles={...}>{children}</RoleGuard> plus a sticky header nav with a logout button (logout() then router.replace('/login')). ROLE_HOME in src/lib/roles.ts already maps kasir/admin->'/staff' and pemilik/admin->'/owner', so FEAT-004 should create src/app/(staff)/staff/... and FEAT-005 src/app/(owner)/owner/... following the same group+layout pattern.
- Reused existing primitives unchanged: useBookings/useBooking/useParts/useServices (hooks/use-queries), useCreateBooking/useUpdateStatus/useAddPart/useRemovePart (hooks/use-mutations), StatusBadge, StatusStepper, PageHeader, EmptyState, ErrorState, LoadingState/TableSkeleton, FormField, formatRupiah/formatDate/formatDateTime, applyApiFieldErrors.
- Status advance control uses nextStatuses() from lib/transitions and explicitly filters out 'Diambil' (admin/kasir-only). Parts add/remove controls are gated to status Diperiksa|Dikerjakan and invalidate both ['bookings'] and ['parts'] query keys (handled inside the mutation hooks) so stock refreshes live; insufficient-stock backend errors surface via the shared toast in use-mutations.
- Invoice PDF: detail page calls invoicePdfBlob(id) (services/bookings) and triggers a browser download via an object URL; button rendered only when status === 'Diambil'.
- Create-online-booking form mirrors createOnlineBookingSchema (plateNumber 3-15, motorModel 2-50, complaint 3-500, optional serviceId from public catalog, optional serviceDate converted to ISO via new Date().toISOString()). A sentinel value '__none__' represents 'no service' in the Select and is stripped before submit (Radix Select cannot use an empty-string item value).
- No API contract changes and no backend edits were needed.
